title: derby01: points
description: What scores. Every car scores for its team over the whole match: damage to other cars, wrecks, knocking off the roof radar, burns (holding a tyre-smoking slide), and the last car standing. Speed cameras pay too (their piece in pieces.json). No single award may be over 5000: the screens send awards up to 5000.

damage.description: Points per point of damage done to a car of another team: paintballs, rams, and shoving it into a wall.

wreck.description: Wrecking a car of another team.

radarHit.description: Every paintball on an enemy's roof radar.

radar.description: Knocking an enemy's radar off (shot off, rammed loose or shaken off).

win.description: The last car standing at the end of a round.

burn.description: Burns: throw the car into a slide on purpose (the handbrake, or full lock on full throttle at speed) and hold the drift or donut. Points = rate × t + grow × t², banked when the slide ends; a hard knock before that loses them.

min.description: Seconds a slide must last to count.

rate.description: Points per second of the burn.

grow.description: Points per second squared: the longer it lasts, the faster it grows.

max.description: Seconds after which a burn banks itself and starts counting again.

grace.description: Seconds a slide may straighten out before the burn ends.

crash.description: A knock harder than this (m/s) during a burn loses it.

announce.description: A banked burn worth at least this is called out in everyone's feed.
